g.text: TOP-01 Two-tier collapsed core, hub at hq with 4 distribution blocks
TOP-02 one 2911 router + one 2960 access switch per site, 10 representative PCs
RT-02 auto-cost reference-bandwidth 10000, passive-interface default, point-to-point transit links, router-ID = Loopback0
RT-03 primary EVPL cost 10, backup cost 100, hello 1 s / dead 4 s
QOS-01 LLQ: DSCP EF (trading) in a 30% priority queue on every WAN edge
WARNING L1-04: 10GBASE-ZR is a non-IEEE vendor optic: both ends need matching vendor optics and interoperability is not guaranteed.
WARNING L1-04: 10GBASE-ER would work with only 0.45 dB to spare (< 1 dB operating margin).
WARNING QOS-01: pt dialect omits the QoS block (PT matrix mqc_llq=untested); the full dialect keeps it.
